title: REFLEX: RNA Ensemble Generation via Flexibility-Calibrated Stochastic Bridge
abstract: arXiv:2610.26261v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: RNA molecules often function through multiple experimentally observed conformational states. A central challenge is to capture ensemble diversity without sacrificing structural fidelity: samples may collapse toward averaged representative structures or drift into unsupported conformational regions. We introduce REFLEX (RNA Ensemble generation calibrated by FLEXibility), a sequence-conditioned generator for RNA backbone-frame ensembles based on a heteroscedastic stochastic bridge on SE(3). During training, experimental B-factors calibrate residue-wise bridge widths, exposing each observed conformer through local perturbation neighborhoods with residue-specific scales while keeping constrained regions sharper. A learned flexibility condition guides the bridge-field network to recover target conformer-specific frames from these calibrated noisy states. translated_title: REFLEX：基于灵活性校准随机桥的RNA构象系综生成
translated_abstract: RNA分子通常通过多个实验观察到的构象状态发挥功能。一个核心挑战是在不牺牲结构保真度的前提下捕捉系综多样性：采样结果可能坍缩为平均化的代表性结构，或漂移到缺乏支持的构象区域。我们提出了REFLEX（RNA Ensemble generation calibrated by FLEXibility，经灵活性校准的RNA系综生成器），这是一种基于SE(3)上异方差随机桥的序列条件RNA主链坐标系综生成器。在训练过程中，实验B因子用于校准逐残基的桥宽度，通过具有残基特异性尺度的局部扰动邻域来呈现每个观察到的构象体，同时保持受限区域更加锐利。学习到的灵活性条件引导桥场网络从这些经校准的噪声状态中恢复目标构象特异性的坐标系。在推理阶段，REFLEX仅使用输入序列，无需MSA子采样启发式方法。
tldr: REFLEX提出了一种基于SE(3)异方差随机桥的序列条件生成模型，利用实验B因子校准逐残基扰动尺度，从单一序列即可生成兼顾结构保真度与构象多样性的RNA系综。
en_tdlr: REFLEX introduces a sequence-conditioned generator based on a heteroscedastic stochastic bridge on SE(3), which uses experimental B-factors to calibrate residue-wise perturbation scales, enabling generation of RNA conformational ensembles with both structural fidelity and diversity from sequence alone.
